top3.headline: Anthropic engineers explain how they rebuilt Claude Managed Agents
top3.whyItMatters: Hosted agent platforms are maturing fast; decide what you build in-house and what you rent.

top3.headline: DeepMind and Mencap turn complex documents into Easy Read in minutes
top3.whyItMatters: Accessibility work that took weeks now takes minutes, with human experts still reviewing every version.

top3.headline: Meng To names Astra 6.2 his favorite model for 3D design
top3.whyItMatters: Taste is becoming a model differentiator; design teams should test models, not just tools.

items.title: Anthropic engineers explain how they rebuilt Claude Managed Agents
items.takeaway: Three Anthropic engineers tell the product iteration story behind the platform's redesigned architecture, with a full conversation on YouTube.
items.soWhat: Anthropic keeps reworking its hosted agent platform; weigh it against building your own agent stack.

items.title: Perplexity's agent built a browser game for about $1,320
items.takeaway: Aravind Srinivas says Perplexity built INU, a browser game set in a robot-filled Tokyo, for about 132,000 Computer credits.
items.soWhat: Agent-built software now has a price tag; compare it with what the same work costs your team.

items.title: Musk sets deadlines he thinks have a 50% chance of success
items.takeaway: In a clip a16z posted, Musk says he keeps addressing the limiting factor and accepts being late half the time.
items.soWhat: Aggressive but plausible deadlines expose the real bottleneck; ask what limits your AI rollout today.

items.title: DeepMind and Mencap build a Gemini tool for Easy Read documents
items.takeaway: It turns complex health, finance and everyday documents into clear words and images in minutes rather than weeks, with experts reviewing every version.
items.soWhat: Accessible versions of key documents can now ship in minutes, if humans still review each one.

items.title: Ruben Hassid's routine for AI answers that aren't the default
items.takeaway: Ask for 20 answers from the usual to the most original, turn on memory, then query a notebook built from a mentor's podcasts.
items.soWhat: Generic AI advice is a commodity; original answers come from your own memory and chosen sources.

items.title: Nathan Benaich says AI-generated inbox slop has skyrocketed
items.takeaway: The investor says neither Gmail spam filtering nor a GPT- or Claude-trained classifier catches it.
items.soWhat: Cheap AI outreach is clogging inboxes that filters can't clean; cold email is losing its signal.

items.title: Meng To calls Astra 6.2 his favorite model for 3D design
items.takeaway: After five days he calls it extremely fast with the best taste in 3D, and open-sourced the four skills he used to steer it.
items.soWhat: Design-strong models still need steering; skills are how teams capture that taste and reuse it.

voices.quote: It turns complex health, finance and everyday documents into clear words and images in minutes rather than weeks – with human experts reviewing every version.
I generally try to aim for a deadline that I at least think is at the 50th percentile.
I started making more skills as a result of this requiring more steering, which is not a bad thing.
gmail spam was never good enough, and neither is a gpt/claude-trained spam classifier

hotOnX.text: Today marks exactly 1 year since Opus 4.5 dropped. I still think it’s the model that changed how we code forever.
hotOnX.note: A year on, builders still credit Opus 4.5 with changing how software gets written.

hotOnX.text: After working for 5 days with Astra 6.2, I've come to love this model the most. It's extremely fast and has the best taste in 3D.
hotOnX.note: A respected 3D designer's model pick shapes what design teams try next.

hotOnX.text: Claude Managed Agents is our platform for developers to build agents that are intelligent and secure.
hotOnX.note: Builders want to see how Anthropic's hosted agent platform works under the hood.

hotOnX.text: Elon Musk on the maniacal sense of urgency behind his companies: "I'm constantly addressing the limiting factor."
hotOnX.note: A concrete deadline rule leaders can test on their own teams.

hotOnX.text: We worked with @mencap_charity and people with learning disabilities to build the Easy Read Co-Creator Tool with Gemini.
hotOnX.note: An AI launch built with the people it serves, with experts checking every output.
